articles.title: Red Sea of Fans Floods London for Arsenal's First Title in 22 Years!
articles.summary: Hundreds of thousands of Arsenal fans turned north London red for a victory parade after the men's team won their first Premier League title in 22 years. The women's team also celebrated winning the first-ever Fifa Women's Champions Cup. One fan called it 'one of the best days of my life.'

articles.title: SPF 30, 50, or 100? What Those Sunscreen Numbers Really Mean
articles.summary: Dermatologists explain that SPF 30 blocks 97% of UVB rays, while SPF 50 blocks 98%. Higher numbers give a little more protection, but no sunscreen blocks 100%. The key is to use enough and reapply often.

articles.title: Ethiopia's Big Election: 50 Million Voters, 47 Parties, and One Big Choice
articles.summary: Over 50 million Ethiopians are registered to vote in a general election on Monday. They will choose from 47 political parties and more than 10,900 candidates. The winning party's leader will become the next prime minister.
